source='''def transform(grid):
    # Separator rows and columns divide the grid into equal-sized cells.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = grid[0][next((c for c in range(w) if any(row[c] != grid[0][0] for row in grid)), 0)]
    # The separator is the color spanning complete rows/columns; ignore the initial row/column.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Identify the repeated separator color from full separator lines.
    line_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows] + [grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols]
    sep_color = max(set(line_colors), key=line_colors.count)
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep_color for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep_color for r in range(h))]
    row_groups = []
    start = 0
    for r in sep_rows + [h]:
        if start < r:
            row_groups.append(list(range(start, r)))
        start = r + 1
    col_groups = []
    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols + [w]:
        if start < c:
            col_groups.append(list(range(start, c)))
        start = c + 1
    colors = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep_color]
    base_color = max(set(colors), key=colors.count)
    mark_color = next((v for v in set(colors) if v != base_color), base_color)
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == mark_color for r in rr for c in cc) == 2 else base_color
             for cc in col_groups] for rr in row_groups]
'''
